body:
You need to add `use Cake\ORM\Query` above your model class.

Also I suggest you used 3.0 branch and latest default app. A lot of changes have been done since alpha1 release.

Thanks for the response. Just to clarify - is that in addition to use Cake\ORM\Query? Just making sure. Also, I installed Cake fresh today via the app skelton and composer. Is that the latest codebase?

> Thanks for the response. Just to clarify - is that in addition to use Cake\ORM\Query?

Yes, if you don't add that `use` statement, PHP will search for the `Query` class within your `App` namespace. Please read up about PHP namespaces if you are not familiar with them.

> Also, I installed Cake fresh today via the app skelton and composer. Is that the latest codebase?

Yes installing using composer will give you the latest codebase. Also remember to run  `composer update` from time to time to stay up to date.
Thanks again - I am relatively new to namespaces. I've been using Cake since version 1 so I'm eager to get involved with this version. I'll be more careful about submitting issues.
We appreciate your interest in 3.0. If you need help developing with 3.0 please post your questions on the cake-php google group or on the `#cakephp` IRC channel.
